mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate signals weakening household demand and rising recession risk, which increases the discount rate and depresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces earnings growth and increases discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of declining real personal consumption expenditures (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising federal funds rates (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in nonfarm payrolls signals strong labor market conditions and rising earnings expectations, which compresses discount rates and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of rising nonfarm payrolls (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the industrial production index signals expanding economic output and rising corporate earnings, which reduces discount rates and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of rising industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the housing starts index signals weakening residential investment and reduced consumer confidence, which increases discount rates and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of declining housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate combined with a decline in nonfarm payrolls signals a significant labor market downturn, which increases recession risk and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months AND PAYEMS declines > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising unemployment and declining payrolls (t-test p > 0.05).
